content.text:
**benchmark — not_conveyed**

The letter reports the sleeve's own returns (2.9% net, 3.1% gross for Q3; 6.1% YTD; 8.7% trailing 12 months) but never mentions the comparison index at all. There is no reference to the real assets policy blend, its composition (40% global listed infrastructure / 30% global REITs / 20% US TIPS / 10% broad commodities), or its 3.4% Q3 2026 return. Notably, this omission removes the context that the sleeve underperformed its benchmark by 0.5 percentage points on a net basis.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph states only: "your portfolio returned 2.9% net of fees (3.1% gross of fees). For the year to date through September 30, 2026, the return was 6.1% net of fees. Over the trailing 12 months through September 30, 2026, the return was 8.7% net of fees." No comparison index, policy blend, or 3.4% figure appears anywhere in the letter, so the benchmark point is entirely absent.
